description: This file implements a C++ source code for the HdmiCecSource plugin, which manages HDMI Consumer Electronics Control (CEC) functionalities in a device. It includes initialization, enabling/disabling CEC, handling hotplug events, power management, device list management, and sending/receiving CEC messages. It interacts with external CEC libraries, IARM bus for system events, and manages device states and events related to HDMI CEC features.

classes.name: HdmiCecSource
classes.description: Main class implementing the HDMI CEC source control plugin, managing CEC enablement, device list, power states, and event handling.

classes.name: HdmiCecSourceFrameListener
classes.description: Class responsible for listening to CEC frames received over the connection.

classes.name: HdmiCecSourceProcessor
classes.description: Class responsible for processing received CEC messages and commands.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up system event handlers, loads settings, and configures CEC if enabled.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters event handlers, and disables CEC.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the device is currently the active source.

methods.name: sendKeyPressEvent
methods.description: Sends a key press event to the device with specified logical address and key code.

methods.name: sendStandbyMessage
methods.description: Sends a standby message via CEC to turn off or standby other devices.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables CEC functionality, optionally persisting setting.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether CEC is currently enabled.

methods.name: setOTPEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables OTP (One-Time Programming) mode, optionally persisting.

methods.name: getOTPEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether OTP mode is enabled.

methods.name: setOSDName
methods.description: Sets the On-Screen Display name for the device.

methods.name: getOSDName
methods.description: Retrieves the current OSD name of the device.

methods.name: setVendorId
methods.description: Sets the vendor ID for the device and persists the setting.

methods.name: getVendorId
methods.description: Retrieves the current vendor ID.

methods.name: performOTPAction
methods.description: Performs OTP-related CEC actions such as device initialization or configuration.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Returns the list of devices connected via CEC.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads CEC related settings from persistent storage.

methods.name: pingDeviceUpdateList
methods.description: Pings a device at a given logical address to check if it is connected. Handles exceptions and updates device list accordingly.

methods.name: sendDeviceUpdateInfo
methods.description: Sends a notification that the device info for a specific logical address has been updated.

methods.name: addDevice
methods.description: Adds a new device with a specified logical address to the internal device list, after validation.

methods.name: removeAllCecDevices
methods.description: Removes all CEC devices from the device list.

methods.name: removeDevice
methods.description: Removes a device with a specified logical address from the device list.

methods.name: sendUnencryptMsg
methods.description: Sends an unencrypted CEC message frame over the connection if CEC is enabled.

methods.name: requestVendorID
methods.description: Sends a CEC message requesting the vendor ID from a specific device.

methods.name: requestOsdName
methods.description: Sends a CEC message requesting the OSD name from a specific device.

methods.name: requestCecDevDetails
methods.description: Requests both vendor ID and OSD name for a device at a given logical address.

methods.name: threadRun
methods.description: Main loop of the polling thread that scans for connected devices and signals updates.

methods.name: threadSendKeyEvent
methods.description: Thread function that waits for key events in a queue and sends corresponding CEC key presses.

methods.name: threadUpdateCheck
methods.description: Thread function that periodically checks the update status of device info like OSD name and Vendor ID, with retries and timeouts.
